title: Candide, ou l’optimisme
author: Voltaire
training: first80% of narrative by Unicode characters; excludes Gutenberg wrapper and preceding title/publisher/editor preface
controls: remaining20% of narrative; training and holdout do not overlap
normalization: lowercase; ß→ss, œ→oe, æ→ae; NFKD; retain a-z; no whitespace
model_format: orders2,3,4; complete26^n little-endian float32 log10 probabilities; .01 pseudocount per entry
corpus_limit: One literary work, not an authentic1937 commercial-telegram corpus; punctuation and numeric material dropped; editorial inline notes remain.
